points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 1e29ab3c archive builds in network-disabled cfd-bench with bundled external dependencies, 2 CPUs/3 GiB/256 processes. CTest registers no tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:53–61 parses --restart but no subsequent source use loads it; case and output arguments are parsed.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, partition, reconstruction, flux, solver, implicit and output modules are separated; output/result provenance remains partial.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal existing-solver invocation identified; no external similarity or authorship investigation performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:73–100 parses JSON and resolves CGNS case path, with no demonstrated two-filename-only restriction.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Immutable 1e29ab3c main.cpp:83–86 reads complete CGNS mesh on every rank; :92–100 builds/partitions a GlobalMesh on every rank. Both rawMesh and gm remain in scope throughout steady loop :150–160 and transient loop; no release occurs. TASK.md:46,227 prohibit full mesh replication during iterations, separately from numbered DQ9 even when METIS is real.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity fallback and CFL caps exist, but several force histories drift despite residual targets, and Re200 accepts relaxed inner ratios as success.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean build passes but CTest registers no tests; validator passes are structural and do not prove force/inner convergence.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Separated source and report; nested floats cause PDF table omissions, and source CLI advertises nonfunctional restart.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
